free_tier.stated: No free text allowance; Model API is pay-as-you-go per token (e.g. Muse Spark standard input USD 1.25 per 1M tokens), with Contributor mode at a discount in exchange for training rights.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK or OpenAI-compatible clients
chaining: no standing free text tier; Contributor mode trades content for lower price, not zero

limits.value: 3,000 RPM and 4,000,000 TPM per team on standard models

identity_cost.detail: an account and API key; no card or phone gate stated on the pricing page

reliability_note: rate limits apply per team, not per API key; Contributor mode uses content to train future models

evidence.proved: Meta Model API bills per token with no free tier stated
evidence.quote: Use our models with pay-as-you-go billing on Meta Model API

notes: No text free tier on the Model API pricing page; Contributor mode is a discount, not a free allowance.
